title: Development Engineer 3 (iOS Developer)
description:

As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. Develop and maintain secure, scalable native iOS applications for the Connected Living – Xfinity App using Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C, Xcode, and MVVM, with hands-on experience in RESTful APIs, frameworks, SDKs, unit testing, and CI/CD. title: Odoo Tech Lead
description:
Hiring: Odoo Tech Lead

**Experience:** 8+ Years  
**Role:** Odoo Tech Lead

* Conduct code reviews and ensure coding standards, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Manage Odoo upgrades, database migrations, deployments, production support, and performance optimization.

* Strong programming knowledge in Python, PostgreSQL, XML, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Excellent understanding of Odoo ORM, framework, security, workflows, reports, and custom module development.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
* Strong knowledge of Git, Linux/Ubuntu, deployment, and production environments.
* Experience with Odoo version upgrades, database migrations, and performance tuning.
* Good understanding of ERP modules such as Sales, CRM, Inventory, Purchase, Accounting, HR, and Manufacturing.
* Proven experience in team leadership, developer mentoring, code reviews, and architecture reviews.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.

Good to Have

* Experience with e-commerce platforms, IoT, WhatsApp Business API, payment gateways, and mobile app integrations.
* Knowledge of SaaS and multi-company implementations.
* Familiarity with Generative AI platforms such as OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude.
* Experience building AI-powered business workflows, chatbots, virtual assistants, and automation solutions within Odoo.

title: Mobile QA Engineer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

**Job Summary**  
We are looking for a highly motivated Mobile QA Engineer with expertise in mobile  
application testing, test automation, and quality assurance processes. The ideal candidate  
should have hands-on experience in testing Android and/or iOS applications, designing  
automated test scripts, executing manual and automation test cycles, and ensuring high  
quality mobile product releases.  
Candidates with strong mobile testing experience and excellent communication skills will  
also be considered, even if they have limited automation exposure.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Mobile Application Testing**  

* Perform end-to-end testing of mobile applications across Android and iOS

platforms.  

* Design, create, and execute comprehensive test cases, test scenarios, and test

plans.  

* Validate application functionality, usability, performance, and compatibility.
* Conduct exploratory, regression, integration, system, and release testing.

**Test Automation**  

* Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test scripts.
* Build and execute automation frameworks for mobile applications.
* Automate functional, regression, and smoke test suites.
* Improve test coverage through automation best practices.

**API Testing**  

* Validate backend APIs supporting mobile applications.
* Perform API testing and automation for service integrations.
* Collaborate with backend teams to validate API responses and workflows.
* Work with Karate Framework where applicable.

**Defect Management & Troubleshooting**  

* Identify, document, track, and verify defects.
* Investigate test failures and application issues.
* Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot and resolve defects.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring quality issues.

**Quality Reporting & Metrics**  

* Generate test execution reports and quality dashboards.
* Analyze testing trends and recommend improvements.
* Provide release readiness assessments.
* Track quality metrics and defect leakage.

**Agile & Team Collaboration**  

* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, reviews, and

retrospectives.  

* Work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and QA teams.
* Support quality improvements across the SDLC.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and share testing best practices.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

* Android Testing
* iOS Testing

* Regression Testing
* Integration Testing
* UAT Support

**Automation Testing**  

* Appium

**Testing Methodologies**

**Professional Skills**

* Communication Skills
* Stakeholder Collaboration

title: Lead Mobile Developer
description:
**ABOUT COMPANY**

**NextGenTechs** is a future-forward technology company accelerating digital transformation through advanced AI-driven products and platforms. Our offerings include AI-powered Learning Management Systems (LMS), GenAI commerce tools, OTT & booking platforms, and custom app development. Trusted by top enterprises and public sector entities across the UK, India, and the Middle East, we bring innovation, compliance, and scale together.

**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

As the Lead Mobile Developer in our Development team, you will drive the technical vision and execution of high-quality, secure, and performant mobile applications within the Information Technology domain. You will set engineering standards, own the mobile architecture, and mentor a team of developers to deliver robust solutions that meet business and user needs. Your role involves hands-on leadership, technical decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure seamless delivery and continuous improvement of our mobile products.

· Own and define the mobile application architecture, technical roadmap, coding standards, and engineering quality benchmarks.

· Lead the end-to-end development of production-grade mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, native iOS/Android, or other agreed technology stacks.

· Design and implement robust integrations with REST/GraphQL APIs, authentication systems, push notifications, analytics, secure storage, and backend services.

· Establish and enforce patterns for state management, offline capabilities, error handling, security, observability, and automated testing.

· Drive code reviews, ensure release readiness, manage app-store deployments, monitor crashes/performance, and resolve incidents efficiently.

· Collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, QA, DevOps, and security teams to deliver reliable, end-to-end user experiences.

· Continuously improve build pipelines, automated testing frameworks, release automation, application performance, and developer productivity.

· Mentor and coach developers, plan technical work, support estimation, and proactively manage delivery risks.

· Champion best practices in mobile engineering, security, and compliance, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and ready for real-world use.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**WORK EXPERIENCE**

· Minimum 5 years of professional experience in mobile application development, with proven expertise in at least one modern mobile technology stack (React Native, Flutter, native iOS/Android).

· Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and shipping production applications to the Apple App Store and/or Google Play Store.

· Hands-on experience with mobile architecture, API integration, authentication, secure storage, push notifications, testing, and performance optimization.

· Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control (e.g., Git), code review processes, crash reporting, analytics, and production support.

· Track record of leading technical design decisions and mentoring engineering teams while remaining hands-on with code.

**React Native architecture:** Native modules, bridges or modern native integration patterns, New Architecture, platform-specific implementations, and dependency management.

**Performance and scalability:** App startup, memory, rendering, network efficiency, battery usage, and smooth media playback.

**Mobile infrastructure:** Build signing, provisioning profiles, certificates, environment configurations, OTA updates where appropriate, and automated release pipelines.

**Security and abuse prevention:** Secure token handling, certificate/network security where appropriate, application integrity checks, and protection against automated abuse.

**Advanced integrations:** Video and audio, live streaming, payments, deep links, universal links, push notifications, and third-party SDKs.

**Production ownership:** Crash analysis, ANR monitoring, observability, phased rollouts, rollback planning, and app-store compliance.

**Cross-platform engineering:** Knowing when shared code is appropriate and when native iOS or Android implementations are necessary.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

· Relevant certifications in mobile development or cloud technologies are advantageous.

**SKILLS / BEHAVIOUR ATTRIBUTES**

· Deep expertise in React Native and/or cross-platform mobile frameworks (Flutter, Xamarin, etc.).

· Strong knowledge of mobile security, accessibility, automated UI testing, and performance tuning.

· Experience integrating AI-enabled features, real-time communications, payments, maps, or enterprise identity solutions is a plus.

· Excellent problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across product and engineering teams.

· Proactive leadership, mentoring, and team-building abilities.

· Adaptability to fast-paced, evolving technology environments and emerging industry trends.

**SALARY RANGE**

· Competitive and commensurate with experience and expertise. (Exact range to be discussed during the interview process.)

Pay: ₹545,000.00 - ₹1,950,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
